minutes_text:
VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  James Schotter, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called the meeting to order at 5 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore

Commissioners Absent: Osborn

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance: Jeff Williams (Mayor’s Office), Randy Zarn (Partners of Parks), Commissioners
emeritus Ryan Antes and Gus Orozco, Alyssa Rivas (VA Long Beach), John Oppenheim (Long
Beach Area Veterans Collaborative), and Jesse Soria (People of the Earth).

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

New Commissioner James Schotter led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54795  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, June 12, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Schotter, seconded by Commissioner
  Hill, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Osborn

2.  24-54796  Recommendation to discuss August Executive Committee meeting.

  Page 1 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Chair Doplemore reported on the Executive Committee (EC) meetings in July,
  August and September. The EC, comprising City staff (Gina Overholt), Chair
  Doplemore and Vice Chair Osborn, are exploring future actions such as creating
  bylaws for the Commission, holding a Commission retreat and revising the
  Veterans Strategic plan, among other topics. She asked Commissioners to review
  the 2024 Point In Time Homeless Count, to review the FY 2025 budget (approved
  on 9/10), and improvements to the Fair Housing Act that will improve access to
  housing for Veterans in need. The Commission discussed a potential motion
  around advocacy for housing and homelessness and decided it should be a future
  agenda item.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Goodin, seconded by Commissioner
  Hill, to approve recommendation to receive and file. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Osborn

3.  24-54798  Recommendation to discuss Long Beach Veteran Stand Down on October 16,
  2024.

  John Oppenheim, Executive Director of Long Beach Area Veterans Collaborative,
  presented on the Stand Down, on October 16, in Veterans Park, which connects
  Veterans in-need to many different services, resources and social support. The VA
  Long Beach is lead organizer. As a non-profit organization, the Collaborative has
  raised funds for this event as well as secured donations of food, and equipment,
  and more. The Collaborative asked the Commission to help spread the word to
  homeless Veterans and Veterans at-risk of homelessness.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Commissioner
  Hill, to approve recommendation to receive and file. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Osborn

4.  24-54799  Recommendation to discuss Beach Streets/Veterans Day Celebration on
  November 09, 2024.

  Page 2 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Commission staffer Overholt reported that this year’s Veterans Celebration, in
  Houghton Park on November 9, serves as the main hub for Beach Streets North
  Long Beach (on the same date). Beach Streets celebrates non-motorized modes of
  transportation and, this year, not only are Veterans a focus, but also showcasing
  the newly completed Artesia Great Blvd. project (Artesia corridor). Event planning
  takes into consideration accessible parking, co-promoting the event to the public
  and to the Veterans community and more. All components of recent Veterans Day
  events will be part of this year’s event as well (e.g. live music, resources fair,
  flyovers), and, because of Beach Streets, there are new features, like an activated
  skate park, and expanded components, such as a much larger Kids Zone. Another
  planning meeting with the Veterans Day subcommittee and Special Events will take
  place next week. Commissioners were invited to participate and to RSVP for the
  meeting.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hill, seconded by Commissioner
  Sramek, to approve recommendation to receive and file. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Osborn

5.  24-54800  Recommendation to discuss Lone Sailor Commemoration on October 13, 2024.

  Randy Zarn, Board member of Partners of Parks, presented on the 20th anniversary
  celebration of Lone Sailor Memorial, taking place on October 13. He invited
  Commissioners to help spread the word to the Veterans community, especially
  Navy, Marine Corps and Merchant Marine Veterans, and to attend themselves.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Sramek, seconded by Commissioner
  Hill, to approve recommendation to receive and file. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Atkins Blade, Goodin, Hill, Schotter, Sramek, Doplemore
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Osborn

PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment on non-agendized items: Jeff Williams from the Mayor’s office, reminded
Commissioners that we need new Commissioners for Council Districts 4 and 8, ideally by October 15,

  Page 3 of 4
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

and for Council District 9 by January. Public comment followed Commission discussions on
agendized items 2 through 5.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Jesse Soria with People of the Earth (POTE) announced a three-day meditation workshop taking
place virtually November 1 through 3, and directed people to POTE’s Instagram page for more
information. Future agenda items: presentation of the FY 2024 Veterans Commission Annual Report,
a HUD-VASH presentation, and the Veterans Banners program.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:22 p.m.
